PostToolUse.command: bash -c 'CHANGED="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; case "$CHANGED" in *.sty) python3 .claude/scripts/lint_sty_structural.py "$CHANGED"; python3 .claude/scripts/lint_traceability.py --changed-file "$CHANGED" ;; *.lvt) .claude/scripts/lint-tests.sh "$CHANGED" ;; esac'
PostToolUse.description: Structural lint .sty files after edit; lint .lvt files after edit; report affected behavioral specs

PreCommit.command: bash -c 'STAGED_STY=$(git diff --cached --name-only -- "*.sty" 2>/dev/null); STAGED_LVT=$(git diff --cached --name-only -- "*.lvt" 2>/dev/null); OK=true; if [ -n "$STAGED_STY" ]; then python3 .claude/scripts/lint_sty_structural.py $STAGED_STY || OK=false; fi; if [ -n "$STAGED_LVT" ]; then .claude/scripts/lint-tests.sh $STAGED_LVT || OK=false; fi; python3 .claude/scripts/lint_traceability.py || OK=false; $OK'
PreCommit.description: Lint staged .sty/.lvt files; check behavioral traceability (fails on broken refs, not low coverage)
